name: PT. Gajah Tunggal Tbk
summary: PT. Gajah Tunggal Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells tires in Indonesia, America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, and Oceania. It offers tyres, tyre cords, synthetic rubber, and tire rubber, inner tubes, flaps, and o-rings, as well as nylon filament yarns. The company's products are used in passenger cars, SUVs, commercial vehicles, off-the-road vehicles, industrial vehicles, motorcycles, and bicycles. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
